item.title: XG Is Excited to See KATSEYE Perform, How They Met The Jonas Brothers, Talks The Core World Tour | AMAs 2026
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to the XG podcast, your go-to source for the latest entertainment news. I'm your host, and today we're bringing you a special report from the American Music Awards 2026.
[Short music transition]
Host: "Our team caught up with some big names on the red carpet, including Chelley Bissainthe and Tetris Kelly from Billboard. We're excited to share that moment with you, straight from the AMAs.
[Short music transition]
Host: "That's all for today's special report from the American Music Awards 2026. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next episode."
[Outro music plays]
